about.heading: Twelve Years of Trusted Dealing
about.para1: Emerald Estates started in 2014 with a single desk in DHA Phase 5 and one rule: never sell a property we wouldn't buy ourselves. That rule built our name — today, most of our business comes from repeat clients and their referrals.
about.para2: From first homes to commercial plazas, our team handles buying, selling and renting across Lahore's premium housing societies — with in-house legal support so your transfer is smooth and safe.
